I didn't record 25 November. It doesn't match the records, so I asked Ilse about it in a thread reply on her #north-team message.

- **What the records say:** the signed 2025–2026 renewal order form (signed 21 Nov 2025) gives 30 November 2026 as the end of the current term, which is the renewal date. The Brackenwater account page, last updated 30 Sep 2026, also says 30 November.
- **What I asked her:** whether 25 November is a newly agreed date or an internal deadline for getting the renewal signed. If the date has really changed, I asked her to point to the document that changes it.
- **Until she answers:** I'm using 30 November as the contract date.

There's also an older CRM note from February 2026 that says 31 December 2026. It disagrees with the signed contract, so I didn't rely on it or mention it to her.

My reply only gave dates, no money terms, so it's fine to post in the channel.
